stories.title: ‘Wonderful staff fighting a rubbish system’ – Inspectors find Glan Clwyd A&E under sustained pressure
stories.summary: Inspectors found a paediatric area left unattended, medicine and equipment that had expired as far back as 2020 and patients being cared for in corridors at Ysbyty Glan Clwyd’s emergency department, according to a report published by Healthcare Inspectorate Wales. stories.title: Family bids farewell as Pontybodkin hair salon Reflections closes
stories.summary: A hair salon that has been part of village life in Pontybodkin for nearly 40 years is closing, with the family behind it holding a farewell afternoon for clients old and new. stories.title: “I am absolutely appalled”: councillors lose fight against Flint HMO plan
stories.summary: Plans to turn a former council house in Flint into a four-person HMO for residents at risk of homelessness have been approved despite local objections. County Councillors Ian Roberts and Cllr Paul Cunningham spoke out against the proposals during a Flintshire Planning Committee meeting. stories.title: Facial recognition technology returns to Chester city centre on Saturday
stories.summary: Cheshire Constabulary will use live facial recognition technology in Chester city centre on Saturday, 12 September, the force’s third deployment of the technology under Operation Vigilant.
